jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
En Konecta, el talento marca la diferencia y sabemos que los grandes profesionales, hacen grandes compañías
Gracias a nuestro equipo, cada vez son más las empresas que confían en nosotros para que podamos brindarles la mejor experiência en cada interacción y en cada punto de contacto con sus clientes.
Por ese motivo, ampliamos nuestra plantilla de una de las grandes empresas bancarias del país con la que trabajamos y, te estamos buscando

¿Qué necesitamos de ti?
- Idioma Inglés: Avanzado
- Accesibilidad Web: Ejecución y análisis de rastreos de diferentes sitios web, y elaboración de planteamientos cualitativos y cuantitativos de oportunidades de mejora (experiência con herramientas como TAW Monitor, Wave, o similares)
- Conocimientos avanzados y experiência en procesos de mejora de accesibilidad documental (experiência en procesos de análisis y corrección de accesibilidad con herramientas como Adobe Acrobat o similares).
- Analítica web: Extracción y análisis (interpretación, resumen... y planteamiento de oportunidades de mejora) de métricas web desde distintas fuentes (como Google Analytics) y presentación de datos y conclusiones a través de informes detallados elaborados de forma autónoma.
- Experiência con QA Testing: Definición, planificación y ejecución de pruebas operativas (manuales) en CMS y otras herramientas de distintas tecnologías y nuevos desarrollos para asegurar correcto funcionamiento de las herramientas.
- Experiência en gestión y participación de proyectos web y colaboración con stakeholders, interlocutores técnicos y proveedores

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Contrato indefinido de lunes a viernes.
Horario de 9h a 18h con una hora de descanso para la comida.
Formación dentro de contrato.
Modalidad de Teletrabajo.
Salario anual bruto: 19.000€

Si tu perfil encaja con esta vacante, anímate a Konectar

jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.company_name: ESML SD Iberia Holding S A U
jobs_results.description: Senior QA Engineer– Marketing & Sales Do you want to make an impact every day by keeping people safe - and by bringing them a sense of security and peace of mind? Interested in being part of a dedicated, passionate team that believes that security is a human right? Looking to join a company where innovation and technology are at the heart of its solutions? Join us today! Present in more than 17 countries across Europe and Latin America, Verisure Securitas Direct is a leader specializing in developing products and services in the home security sector. We are an award-winning ‘Internet of Things company, having amassed a ton of experience and expertise for over more than 30 years. Unlike many competitors, we keep most work in-house to guarantee premium quality every step of the way. Our office in Madrid is a top R&D Center in the connected smart home market. Here we create and develop services and products for home security and home automation. We are looking for people who can make a... tangible positive impact in delivering breakthrough innovation in Research & Development to transform and add value, not only to our Company but the industry itself. Main Responsibilities We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who set up and lead the QA strategy for the Marketing and Sales domains in our 17 Countries. Define and implement the test strategy of the Global Marketing and Sales IT department. Align this implementation and tools used with the QA discipline in the company. Collaborate with the discipline with create the best in class QA processes in the company. Define the way of working regarding QA aligned with the product owner, technical lead and scrum master. Lead the execution of this QA strategy and implementation of this way of working in each of the scrum teams aligned with the priorities and situation of each project. Manage performance of the QA test together with the product owners and technical leads of each team (6-7 people). Work together with the Service/Maintenance team, QA team and developers to drive to 0 the bugs in production. Implement a continuous improvement mindset within the QA team and other members of the company with the objective of maximize the quality in production. Improve testing processes like implementation of E2E scenarios which covers critical processes. Define and lead the implementation of the testing automation strategy. Lead the implementation of the device farm project and promote the usage in the company. Build reports to understand the QA situation within the teams. Report status of implementation of the strategy to middle and senior management. Competencies Strategic mindset and leadership skills to lead a team and the implementation of the strategy. 5+ years’ experience leading QA teams 10+ years’ experience in testing Experience with testing plugin in JIRA, Confluence. Experience with devices farm tools (Google, AWS, Saculelabs) Experience with testing automation tools (selenium, webdriver.io, apium) Experience working in international environment Experience managing senior management stakeholders Functional understanding of the marketing and sales business Experience with Agile Methodologies/lean and tools: JIRA, Confluence, etc. Ability to clearly communicate with peers, manager and senior managers Ability to function with new technologies Requirements Education: Master/ B.A in Computer Engineer or Telecommunications English B2 Other Competencies: Service culture, continuous improvement mindset Critical thinking and problem solving abilities to address complex issues involving data movement and data replication Proactive and dynamic person Must be a self-starter as well as a good team player. Good communication skills. Leadership skills to help technical lead with the team motivation to learn new methodologies. We Offer Passion for our People We believe that we make a difference every day. To do that, we need committed and engaged employees. Our people are accountable for delivering world-class service and they are passionate about making the world a safer and more secure place. Our teams operate with integrity and respect for one another fueled by an entrepreneurial spirit. We are building a high-performance organization through investing in our people with great development and growth opportunities. We also offer hybrid working model. Passion for Innovation We are a growth company. Our continuous investment in innovation has led to consistent top and bottom-line growth. The more we grow, the safer the world becomes. Our Investors We are owned by a leading private equity firm: Hellman & Friedman. Our sponsor has invested in our innovation pipeline and in our organization to fuel our accelerated growth and play a leading role in the industry. We are Verisure – and we are Proud to Protect Verisure is the leading provider of professionally-monitored smart alarms for residential households and small businesses in Europe, and we are growing in Latin America. We trade as Verisure in most of the countries where we operate, and as Securitas Direct in Spain and Portugal. We protect more than three million customers in 16 countries. Our business model integrates product development, design and sales with installation, outstanding service and a 24/7 professional monitoring solution. We protect people from intrusion, fire and flood - and we save lives. We believe it is a human right to feel safe and secure. It takes passionate people to protect Protecting what matters most for our customers takes innovative technology and, above all, passionate people. People who are driven by our purpose. Every one of our 17,000 colleagues takes this responsibility to protect seriously. Every day, they demonstrate our DNA – the unique imprint we look for, nurture and unleash in every member of our Verisure family. Our people strategy is clear: to create the best, winning team. We do this by finding and attracting the very best talent; by growing and nurturing the talent we already have; and by engaging our people around our vision, our strategy and our DNA. And with more than 80% of our colleagues interacting with our customers every day, they personally deliver our customer promise: to protect what matters most. Do you have what it takes to be Proud to Protect? Would you like to be part of the next phase of our successful growth story? We are looking forward to receive your application

jobs_results.title: Game Tester: Arabic
jobs_results.description:
Localsoft, S.L. is a world-class localization company offering translation, testing and audio services. From our headquarters in the Málaga TechPark in Málaga, Spain, we operate both locally and internationally with clients from many different business sectors including leading brands in the Games, IT, Legal and Business industries.

We are currently hiring Arabic (MSA) Language Game Testers to work in our HQ in Málaga, Spain.

If you have previous game testing experience or you are an avid gamer with excellent linguistic skills, we would like to hear from you!

As a Game Tester you will be testing games to detect and report grammar, spelling, punctuation and other linguistic and cultural errors in your native language.

Visit: www.localsoftgames.com

Responsibilities
• Follow company policy and values
• Follow established processes, instructions and QA checklists
• Take full ownership of each phase in the project life cycle
• Successfully complete tasks to the highest standards
• Be... aligned with Localsoft’s security and code of conduct
• Willingness to learn and improve, support other team members and go the extra mile

Requirements
• English with full working proficiency.
• Excellent native language skills
• Capacity to work in a multicultural, dynamic and deadline-driven work environment
• Good knowledge of game genres and platforms is a plus
• Good teamwork and interpersonal skills
• Proactive and positive “can do” attitude
• Understanding the importance of quality, customer service, confidentiality and security

Benefits
• Opportunity to work with a professional international team in a dynamic and friendly work environment
• Opportunity to work with renowned clients (publishers/developers)
• Cafeteria & Games
• Soft Drinks
• Fresh Fruit

Additional information
• Valid work permit for Spain is required
• Testing is performed in Localsoft’s secure testing lab in Málaga, Spain
• Remote work is not possible

jobs_results.title: Quality Assurance Tester
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

2+ years of professional experience in functional testing.
• Aptitude to learn Ria applications quickly and able to work independently.
• Familiar with Agile methodology and able to participate in sprint grooming, daily stand ups and retrospective meetings.
• Good knowledge of QA Test estimation, Test Plan & test case creation, test execution, bug creation and bug reporting.
• Proactive in identifying gaps/dependencies in the requirements in the initial phases of SDLC process.
• Report bugs and errors to development teams and help troubleshoot issues
• Proficient in using test management tools like Quality Center, Jira, TFS, Azure DevOps.
• Able to understand backend processes
• Work with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle
• Good team player and helps other QA Analysts in keeping critical deadlines.
• Works with geographically distributed teams to perform daily duties.
• Helps in Investigating and troubleshooting... production issues with the support teams and in resolving the issues on time.
• Able to multitask and handle conflicting priorities effectively.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

jobs_results.title: Security QA (100% Remote)
jobs_results.description:
We're on a mission to create the most innovative and industry-leading cryptocurrencies exchange.

Our team is globally distributed and fully remote, so excellent English communication skills are critical for when we collaborate together to develop, support, and deliver the best platform possible for our users. If you get excited about being in an industry that is breaking new ground and have a disposition of confidence towards challenging technical feats and learning new and complex products, we want to talk to you.

We’re looking for a Security QA to play a crucial role in ensuring the security and integrity of the exchange platform and its associated services & products.

Our team is globally distributed and fully remote, so excellent English communication skills are critical. The position of Security QA involves detecting and evaluating the security measures and vulnerabilities within our desktop, web, and API products. The primary goal is to identify and mitigate security risks to... safeguard customer assets, and maintain the company's reputation for trustworthiness and reliability.

Key Responsibilities:
• Security Testing:
• Conduct comprehensive security testing on Desktop / Web / API products to identify vulnerabilities, security flaws, and potential risks.
• Use various security testing tools, methodologies, and techniques to evaluate API endpoints and data exchanges.
• Vulnerability Assessment:
• Perform security assessments to identify and prioritize potential vulnerabilities, such as authentication issues, injection attacks, and data leakage.
• Document and report identified vulnerabilities and provide recommendations for remediation.
• Penetration Testing:
• Conduct penetration testing to simulate real-world attacks.
• Analyze our products' resilience to common attack vectors and security threats.
• Privilege Scope and Escalation:
• Analyze our products for horizontal / vertical privilege escalation vectors.
• Analyze access levels to determine if the scope and request limits are sufficient and secure.
• Test Case Creation:
• Develop detailed test cases and test scenarios to systematically evaluate the products' security posture.
• Collaborate with the development and security teams to establish testing criteria and requirements.
• Security Tools and Methodologies:
• Stay up-to-date with the latest security testing tools, techniques, and industry best practices.
• Implement security testing methodologies, including OWASP Top Ten and other relevant standards.
• Reporting and Documentation:
• Create clear and concise security assessment reports that highlight findings and recommendations for remediation.
• Collaborate with the development and security teams to ensure vulnerabilities are properly addressed and resolved.
• Continuous Monitoring:
• Implement ongoing monitoring and testing to identify new security threats and vulnerabilities.
• Assist in the development and implementation of security policies and procedures.
• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.
• Knowledge of cryptocurrency technology, and the cryptocurrency exchange ecosystem.
• Proficiency in Desktop / Web / API security testing methodologies and tools.
• Familiarity with security standards, such as OWASP, NIST, and ISO 27001.
• Knowledge of penetration testing techniques and tools.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
• Relevant certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) are a plus.

A Security QA Tester is a critical role in safeguarding the assets and trust of customers on the platform. Your efforts will contribute to the overall security and integrity of the exchange, ensuring a safe and reliable environment for trading and financial transactions in the cryptocurrency space

jobs_results.description:
¡En Konecta, el talento marca la diferencia y sabemos que los grandes profesionales, hacen grandes compañías!

Gracias a nuestro equipo, cada vez son más las empresas que confían en nosotros para que podamos brindarles la mejor experiencia en cada interacción y en cada punto de contacto con sus clientes.

Por ese motivo, ampliamos nuestra plantilla de una de las grandes empresas bancarias del país con la que trabajamos y, ¡te estamos buscando!

Funciones principales:
• Accesibilidad Web y SEO: Ejecución y análisis de rastreos de diferentes sitios web, y elaboración de planteamientos cualitativos y cuantitativos de oportunidades de mejora.
• Analítica Web: Extracción y análisis de métricas web desde distintas fuentes y presentación de datos y conclusiones a través de informes detallados.
• Q.A. Testing: Definición, planificación y ejecución de pruebas operativas (manuales y automatizadas) en CMS y otras herramientas de distintas tecnologías y nuevos desarrollos para asegurar correcto... funcionamiento de las herramientas.
• Validaciones y pruebas regresivas en distintas aplicaciones tras despliegues o intervenciones planificadas.
• Soporte a equipos de gestión de contenidos web.

¿Qué buscamos?
• Inglés (nivel alto hablado y escrito).
• Experiencia con herramientas de comprobación de accesibilidad web (TAW Monitor, Wave, o similares) y documental (Adobe Acrobat, o similares).
• Experiencia con rastreadores web como Screaming Frog, OnCrawl, o similares.
• Conocimientos básicos de HTML, CSS, JavaScript y Phyton.
• Experiencia con herramientas de SEO (como Google Search Console, ScreamingFrog, OnCrawl, u otras similares).
• Conocimientos y experiencia en gestión de contenidos web (valorable experiencia en CMS).
• Conocimientos básicos de analítica web y medición de datos.
• Experiencia en QA Testing y procesos de automatización de pruebas.
• Experiencia con software de pruebas automatizadas como Selenium, Katalon o similares.
• Experiencia con herramientas de medición de datos analíticos (como Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, IBM Watson u otros similares).
• Experiencia con herramientas de reportes y generación de dashboards automatizados (como Google DataStudio, Microsoft Power BI u otras similares).

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Contrato indefinido de lunes a viernes.
• Horario de 9h a 18h con una hora de descanso para la comida.
• Formación dentro de contrato.
• Modalidad de Teletrabajo.
• Salario anual bruto: 19.000€

jobs_results.title: SENIOR QA TESTER
jobs_results.description:
Embrace the gaming revolution with Maniac Panda Games, the video game studio powered by Nexxyo Labs! We're not just imagining; we're actively crafting new ways to immerse players in the exhilarating world of gaming.

Are you ready to redefine how the world enjoys games?

We’re looking for SENIOR QA TESTER to join us! Requisitos mínimos

You have 2 years of experience in game testing (any platform).
You have gaming knowledge and passion.
You have good attention to detail.
You have good communication and organizational skills.
You have experience working with Jira and Confluence.
You have Agile working methodologies.
You are used to the game development process.
You are able to work with remote teams.
English Language - at least a basic conversation level is required, the team is growing internationally.
Requisitos deseados

You have degree in Game Design, Art or Programming.
You have equivalent experience like Software Testing or Game Journalism.
You have Automation Testing skills.
You... have Game engine experience (Unreal, Unity, GameMaker, etc.).
Responsabilidades

Creation and maintenance of Test Cases and Checklist for Smoke and Functional Testing.
Integral testing of projects from its first Alpha to post-launch.
Knowledge of the tools needed for testing videogames on PC, video recording, and edition.
Detailed and efficient reporting of issues, feedback and improvements on those projects.
Regression checks on the issues already fixed by the Design and Development Team.
Direct coordination with that Team and active participation in continuous meetings.
Comprehensive maintenance of the Issue Database health and issue triage in Atlassian Jira.
Organization, creation, and review of documentation in Atlassian Confluence.
Beneficios

Industry competitive salary based on experience and skills.
Flexible working hours.
Reduced working hours in August.
Participate in the AAA videogame company with the greatest projection in Spain.
Being part of a studio with a team of more than 100 professionals in Marketing, Videogames and Blockchain.
Opportunity to grow within an expanding company.

About us:

Nexxyo Labs, a young vibrant technology company headquartered in Navarra. At Nexxyo, we are not just shaping the future; we are redefining it, introducing new ways to enjoy games, and pushing the boundaries of what"s possible in the tech industry.

Going beyond the conventional, our commitment extends to bringing blockchain gaming to the world. Rooted in our dual mission of delivering entertainment and fostering a global gaming community, we continually push the envelope of innovation with Web3 technology, ensuring enduring value for each player.

Please send your CV to: Ver el correo electrónico en stratos-ad.com
